title: BERxiT: Early Exiting for BERT with Better Fine-Tuning and Extension to Regression
selection_reason: BERTの各層にexit判断を設け、容易な入力は後段層を実行せず推論計算を削減するearly-exit方式。classificationだけでなくregressionへLearning-to-Exitを拡張し、実推論時間削減を評価するため直接対象。
venue: Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics
